title: Revision and snapshots
summary: Explicit refresh updates eligible admitted cases and their existing owner snapshot atomically, preserving targets, provenance, passed acceptance and capture history. Successful captures awaiting review can continue an inherited machine chain; independent judgment still follows complete capture. Item refresh skips shared copies on runs the item has left, preserving remaining members and their live walks. The plan filter belongs only to deployment refresh; item refresh refuses it with recovery. Removed-member stale rows offer no unreachable refresh recipe. Item gate materialization keeps each attached plan snapshot stable across retries. For an explicit replacement, retain the failed case and add a distinct corrected key; when that key exists in the applicable current plan but not the snapshot, replacement_materialization_stale names the item, transition and project rematerialize command followed by the replacement declaration. Unknown keys, ambiguous cases and wrong obligation scope have separate diagnoses. Refresh updates matching rows, adds eligible cases and retires removed cases; a removed post-deploy case may already acquire its unambiguous automatic successor. Corrected code under the same case uses an ordinary retry without --replaces. Adding a case during a live walk refuses with the abort/retry command and rolls back the whole refresh.
